glosses: in allerlei richtingen gaan
bij elke persoon of elk voorwerp uit een groep langsgaan

examples.text: Welke geruchten over de oorlog in Oekraïne gaan er rond?

glosses: To have (something) as a primary focus.
to move in circles or through a circuit
to cause (a person or thing) to move in circles or through a circuit
to move from person to person, as at a party

examples.text: In both the 2005 and 2013 papal elections there were whispers circulating that back in 1976 Francis had failed to help the two priests in their hour of need.

glosses: to spread or disseminate
to become widely known
Of decimals: to repeat.
to avoid or get around something; to bypass

examples.text: The line turns a sharp right-angle to the north to circumvent the town, and then plunges straight into the 1 in 50, which lasts for nearly 20 miles with few intermissions, and some pitches of 1 in 40.

glosses: to surround or besiege
to outwit or outsmart

examples.text: We are mortified by not being thought worthy of trust; and there is also a feeling of small triumph in circumventing those who doubt either our inclination or our power of service.

glosses: To move or spread from person to person.

examples.text: The rumor is going around that Mr. X and Ms. Y are having an affair. There's a cough going around.

“[…] if you call my duds a ‘livery’ again there'll be trouble. It's bad enough to go around togged out like a life saver on a drill day, but I can stand that 'cause I'm paid for it. What I won't stand is to have them togs called a livery. […]”

glosses: To visit (a place) or with (somebody).

examples.text: I'm going around to John's house later.

glosses: To fight or argue; to obsess over something.
To be shared with everyone.

examples.text: There's plenty of fish to go around.

glosses: To perform a go-around maneuver.

examples.text: ATC told the flight to go around because another plane was still on the runway.

glosses: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see go, around.

examples.text: Let's make the wheels go around.
